excerpts.content:
since I was planning to bring up 8413 on ACDC as a potential orthogonal solution to 8205, posting it here: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12306/changes 

This does not completely solve the front-running issue because you can add stake and the operator can choose to not register against your stake.
